verdict.rationale: Brex is a fintech platform with banking APIs, so an embedded-banking (banking-as-a-service) story is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence shows no capability for developers to offer Brex-backed accounts to their own customers under Brex's license. The Onboarding API only refers customers to Brex and prefills their signup, which is adjacent rather than embedded banking. The other APIs (Transactions, Payments, Team) operate on the developer's own Brex account.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer embedded banking accounts to my customers without holding my own financial license
